data.short_meaning: Rama - God; Lingam - Symbol of God
data.long_meaning: Ramalingam is a name of God in Hinduism. It is a combination of the words Rama and Lingam. Rama refers to the God Vishnu in his incarnation as Rama, while Lingam is a symbol of Shiva. The name signifies the unity of these two important deities in Hinduism. The name Ramalingam carries the meaning “Rama - God; Lingam - Symbol of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ramalingam usually hope their child will grow to embody rama - god; lingam - symbol of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ramalingam is a name that embodies the divine presence of both Vishnu and Shiva. It is a powerful name that is believed to bring strength, courage, and divine protection.
data.etymology: Ramalingam belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rama - God; Lingam - Symbol of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramalingam total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
